result.reason: The operative language reaches at least the fallback by covering affiliates and permitting transfer in connection with a merger, reorganization, or sale, and it also covers contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf. It does not itself establish the preferred perpetual, irrevocable, or breach-limited termination protections; the margin comment cannot supply those terms. The redline is overbroad because Section (d) unnecessarily gives Garman a new consent-free assignment right, and Section (c)'s exceptions grammatically permit affiliates, contractors, and successors to lease or export the Work, not merely use or receive the intended licence. Those changes are unnecessary and may alter unrelated commercial restrictions.
